_meta.policy: A gate failure on any advisory >= audit-level absent from this ledger, or on any entry past nextReviewDate, is a hard fail. Renewal requires re-triage.

exceptions.title: ajv has ReDoS when using `$data` option
exceptions.introducedBy: web3@^1.10.4 (EOL, archived upstream) closure; truffle-era dev chain where applicable
exceptions.reason: No compatible fix exists: web3.js is sunset/archived upstream (ChainSafe 2025-01, EF archive 2025-03), so every advisory in its closure is fixed only by the web3@4 major (also archived) or by the planned viem/ethers rewrite. Parent pins in the truffle chain block in-range bumps.
mitigations: Runtime reach is nil: no server-side process requires('web3'); the npm package exists only to serve the browser bundle, which never invokes the vulnerable paths (tar/request/form-data/swarm upload, local ECDSA signing via web3-eth-accounts)
All transaction signing is performed by the injected wallet (MetaMask) via EIP-1193, not by any bundled crypto-shim (elliptic/pbkdf2/sha.js/cipher-base)
web3-bzz/web3-shh modules are unused by the DApp UI
Dev-chain advisories (mocha/webpack/js-yaml/minimatch/diff etc.) execute only at lint/build time on trusted local sources
exceptions.approvedBy: NKA <aidev@neuzida.io> (interim approval 2026-11-04; dissolves at the planned breaking-change overhaul)

exceptions.title: webpack buildHttp: allowedUris allow-list bypass via URL userinfo (@) leading to build-time SSRF behavior
exceptions.introducedBy: web3@^1.10.4 (EOL, archived upstream) closure; truffle-era dev chain where applicable
exceptions.reason: No compatible fix exists: web3.js is sunset/archived upstream (ChainSafe 2025-01, EF archive 2025-03), so every advisory in its closure is fixed only by the web3@4 major (also archived) or by the planned viem/ethers rewrite. Parent pins in the truffle chain block in-range bumps.
mitigations: Runtime reach is nil: no server-side process requires('web3'); the npm package exists only to serve the browser bundle, which never invokes the vulnerable paths (tar/request/form-data/swarm upload, local ECDSA signing via web3-eth-accounts)
All transaction signing is performed by the injected wallet (MetaMask) via EIP-1193, not by any bundled crypto-shim (elliptic/pbkdf2/sha.js/cipher-base)
web3-bzz/web3-shh modules are unused by the DApp UI
Dev-chain advisories (mocha/webpack/js-yaml/minimatch/diff etc.) execute only at lint/build time on trusted local sources
